title: OMEGA-3
style: warm documentary photography, morning kitchen light, natural textures, soft shadows, muted earthy palette, shallow depth of field, high detail

music.tags: gentle sunrise ambient, soft solo piano, warm string pad, distant solo clarinet, calm, spacious, instrumental

beats.prompt: A fillet of oily fish on ice on a steel counter, close-up, cold blue light, glistening surface
beats.motion: Ice melts very slowly. A drop runs down.
beats.caption: Your body cannot make these

line.text: Omega-3s are fats your body cannot make. You have to eat them.

beats.sfx: ice shifting on a steel counter

beats.prompt: Amber capsules spilled on a pale surface beside a glass of water, soft daylight, shallow depth of field
beats.motion: The capsules settle. Light glints across them.
beats.caption: EPA and DHA do most of the work

line.text: Two of them do most of the work in the research: EPA and DHA. Both come mainly from marine sources.

beats.prompt: A plate of grilled salmon and greens on a wooden table, warm kitchen light, documentary style
beats.caption: Fish twice a week gets most people there

line.text: Eating fish a couple of times a week gets most people there without a bottle.

beats.prompt: A row of unlabelled amber bottles on a shelf, soft light, muted palette, clean composition
beats.motion: Light shifts slowly along the shelf.
beats.caption: Freshness matters more than people think

line.text: Supplements are for filling the gap when that does not happen. Freshness matters more than people think - rancid oil is common.

beats.prompt: A clean empty plate and a glass of water on a wooden table, morning light, calm
beats.caption: Not medical advice

line.text: General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
